observation: The active claim stored one persistent expectedCandidateSha. After an accepted branch commit, that field necessarily became stale even when the same legitimate session continued.
brokenInvariant: A mutable branch CAS must be evaluated against the immediate pre-mutation parent; a persistent claim projection cannot equal both the pre- and post-mutation head.
failureFamily: stale-writer false positive after successful own commit
claim projection masquerading as mutation CAS authority
selectedRepair: Claim owns scope, revision and fencing token. Every mutation supplies a live expectedParentSha separately and GitHub rejects non-fast-forward/stale-parent updates. The claim projection records lastObservedHeadSha but does not assert it remains current after its own mutation.
introducedRisks: caller may forget to re-read live head before mutation
defenses: event records expected parent and resulting commit
claim fencing still invalidates superseded writers
rollback: Release T0501 claim and abandon PR #60 without merge.
permanentRegression: A future coordination validator must reject any claim model that requires a mutable branch projection to equal its own post-write head without a separate per-mutation CAS input.
